name: Chunk 1/32

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk Policy
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's formal policy governing the identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of operational risks across the organisation. The policy is owned by the Chief Risk Officer and applies to Risk, Operations, All Staff, and the Board. It is mandated by the PRA Rulebook (Pillar 2) and Basel III Operational Risk framework.
context: Regulatory Reference | PRA Rulebook (Pillar 2), Basel III Operational Risk

raw_entities.name: PRA Rulebook (Pillar 2)
raw_entities.description: Prudential Regulation Authority regulatory framework establishing capital and risk management requirements for operational risk. This is a primary regulatory basis for FirstUK Bank's Operational Risk Policy.
context: Regulatory Reference | PRA Rulebook (Pillar 2), Basel III Operational Risk

raw_entities.name: Basel III Operational Risk
raw_entities.description: International banking regulatory standard establishing operational risk capital requirements and risk management principles. Forms part of the regulatory basis for FirstUK Bank's Operational Risk Policy.
context: Regulatory Reference | PRA Rulebook (Pillar 2), Basel III Operational Risk

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of loss resulting from inadequate or failed internal processes, people, systems, or external events. This is the primary risk category addressed by FirstUK Bank's Operational Risk Policy.

raw_entities.name: Chief Risk Officer
raw_entities.description: Executive role responsible for ownership and governance of the Operational Risk Policy at FirstUK Bank. The Chief Risk Officer has accountability for policy implementation, review, and effectiveness across the organisation.

raw_entities.name: All Staff
raw_entities.description: All employees of FirstUK Bank are identified as an audience for the Operational Risk Policy, indicating that operational risk management responsibilities apply across the entire organisation.
context: Audience | Risk, Operations, All Staff, Board

raw_entities.name: Board
raw_entities.description: The Board of FirstUK Bank is identified as an audience for the Operational Risk Policy, indicating Board-level accountability for operational risk governance and oversight.
context: Audience | Risk, Operations, All Staff, Board
